title: Multi-Pump Switching Control System
requirements:
In an industrial water supply system, there are 5 pumps, each of which can be controlled independently. The system needs to support both manual and automatic operating modes.
Based on the value of the mode variable, switch to the corresponding operating mode.
In manual mode, control the start and stop of the selected pump based on the value of pumpGroup[1..5].selection.
In automatic mode, compare the priority of each pump, and automatically select the 3 pumps with higher priority for water supply according to the method of three in use and two on standby.

variables.name: start
variables.description: Start button, used to start the manually selected or automatically selected pump

variables.name: stop
variables.description: Stop button, used to stop all pumps

variables.name: pumpGroup
variables.description: Five pump records passed by reference. Read priority and selection; write only RunComd.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Priority; larger values have higher priority. Read-only to the function block.

fields.name: selection
fields.description: Manual-selection state. Read-only to the function block.

fields.name: RunComd
fields.description: Run command written by the function block; TRUE runs and FALSE stops.

specs.text: 当停止按钮为 TRUE 时，五台泵的运行命令必须全部为 FALSE（停止优先于手动/自动方式）。

specs.text: 当启动按钮为 FALSE 时，任何一台泵都不得收到运行命令。
specs.ltl: G(NOT start -> (pumpGroup[1].RunComd = FALSE AND pumpGroup[2].RunComd = FALSE AND pumpGroup[3].RunComd = FALSE AND pumpGroup[4].RunComd = FALSE AND pumpGroup[5].RunComd = FALSE))

specs.text: 手动方式下，未被选中的泵必须收到停机命令（selection=FALSE → RunComd=FALSE）。

specs.text: 自动方式按 priority 选前三台运行、其余两台备用停机；优先级相等时下标小者优先（三用两备规则，由 m01-2/6/8/10 用例验证的数据性质）。

# Multi-Pump Switching Control System - **Difficulty:** Medium (medium) ## Requirements In an industrial water supply system, there are 5 pumps, each of which can be controlled independently. The system needs to support both manual and automatic operating modes. Based on the value of the mode variable, switch to the corresponding operating mode. In manual mode, control the start and stop of the selected pump based on the value of pumpGroup[1..5].selection. In automatic mode, compare the priority of each pump, and automatically select the 3 pumps with higher priority for water supply according to the method of three in use and two on standby. ## Interface Definition | Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Input | `mode` | `BOOL` | FALSE: Manual mode
TRUE: Automatic mode | | Input | `start` | `BOOL` | Start button, used to start the manually selected or automatically selected pump | | Input | `stop` | `BOOL` | Stop button, used to stop all pumps | | Input/Output | `pumpGroup` | `ARRAY[1..5] OF ST_Pump` | Five pump records passed by reference. Read priority and selection; write only RunComd. | **Data type `ST_Pump`** | Field | Data Type | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `priority` | `INT` | Priority; larger values have higher priority.
